tasks.label: adb reverse (dev 5126)
tasks.detail: Bridge a USB-connected phone's localhost:5126 to the laptop's API (dotnet run).

tasks.label: adb reverse (docker 5121)
tasks.detail: Bridge a USB-connected phone's localhost:5121 to the laptop's API (docker compose).

tasks.label: run mobile over Wi-Fi (dev 5126)
tasks.detail: Connect the phone over Wi-Fi (adb tcpip), adb reverse, then flutter run. Cable needed only the first time / after a phone reboot.

tasks.label: run mobile over Wi-Fi (docker 5121)
tasks.detail: Same as above but against the docker-compose API on 5121 (env.docker.json).
